metadata.title: Retro Studio Portrait with Diagonal Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A centered male portrait with hands held up toward the camera, framed by diagonal text lines in the upper corners.
triggerTerms: retro male portrait with hands forward
excludeWhen: modern high-contrast digital lighting is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-shot portrait of a man with dark curly hair and a mustache, wearing a patterned open shirt over a dark tee. He holds both hands up, palms facing forward, creating a framing effect for his face. The background is a neutral, slightly vignetted studio backdrop. Text is placed at a 30-degree upward angle in the top-left and top-right corners, underlined by thin parallel rules.
coreVisualRelationships: Hands in foreground creating depth and framing the face
Diagonal text lines mirroring each other in upper corners
Patterned shirt contrasting with solid dark pants and undershirt
coreInvariants: Direct eye contact with the camera

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is central, occupying 80% of the vertical frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, framed by his own hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move outward to the hands, then follow the diagonal text lines to the corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper corners to accommodate the angled typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for pants and undershirt
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white with dark blue patterns on the overshirt
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a focus on tonal range and soft shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Serif with moderate weight and italic slant
letterConstructionRules: Underlined by a thin rule following the baseline angle

typesetting.alignment: Left and Right justified to corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in two mirrored locations for symmetry.
graphicDevices: Thin diagonal rules underlining the text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic transitional serif structure and availability.
Provides the high contrast and elegant serifs seen in the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man with 1970s curly hair and mustache, wearing a patterned short-sleeve shirt over a black tee, holding his hands up toward the camera in a framing gesture, against a neutral grey studio backdrop.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of serif italic text in the top-left and top-right corners, rotated 30 degrees upward, with a thin matching rule beneath each line.

verificationChecks: Subject is centered with hands forward
Background is a neutral studio gradient

adjustableVariables: Specific angle of the text (20-40 degrees)
mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names or titles from the original image
Do not replicate specific brand logos
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the subject's head
Verify the diagonal rules are parallel to the text baseline
Check that the hands are in focus in the foreground
Confirm the lighting is soft and directional
recipe.reuseFormula: Center-weighted portrait + Mirror-diagonal corner typography + 1970s styling.
